profile.headline: Retired
profile.geoLocationName: Salt Lake City, Utah, United States
profile.summary:
Objective 	

To provide automated software build/release services including reports, status, availability and reproducibility on a regular basis for an engineering organization. Provide organization with build/configuration/release services from source tree creation through test and release.

Accomplishments include: 

Created and implemented agile automated build, notification, test and auditing system using CVS, Perforce, Subversion, MySQL and Perl for  Unix, Linux, Solaris, HPUX and Windows. Manage release/patch/hotfix cycles for large portal system. Created and implemented web tools for tree and build monitoring along with limited integration into defect tracking system. Created automated build installation and smoke test deployment system for complex portal product in order to verify all builds before delivery to test department greatly enhancing their productivity.

Released open source continuous automated build and integration environment. CABIE is available for download at http://cabie.tigris.org.

Managed installation, and conversion of 400k line portal project from CVS to Perforce at SungardSCT in Salt Lake City.  Created training course for developers transitioning from CVS to Perforce.

Managed roll out of configuration management system in the Citrix Salt Lake development facility.  

Implemented source code browsing utility over the web for use by engineering departments world wide to provide easy and efficient cross reference of functions, symbols, classes, and dependencies for all projects being developed in the Citrix Salt Lake facility. 

Created an automated web based test harness for the ICA (Independent Computing Architecture) client for Java which eliminated the need for manual entry of test results.

While at Novell created a Process Manager for NetWare to display CPU, Memory utilization, running NetWare processes, Java processes, and allowing the launching of new Java processes using a combination of Java. JNI and RMI.

Specialties: Configuration/Build Management specializing in the automation of development environments. Involved in software/hardware engineering for the past 18 years providing complete support for development organizations from source trees through media verification and product release. Skilled in Unix, NT environments, configuration management tools, build tools, and scripting languages.

positions.title: Staff Software Development Engineer
positions.description: Converted automated builds from Buildbot to Jenkins reducing build job creation and deployment by weeks.  Participated in conversion of source trees from SVN to Git.  Developed searchable database scraper to retain Jenkins build records using Python, Django and CSS. Integrated Google charts into Jenkins database scraper. Developed a ‘team deployable’ Jenkins within Control4 to ensure plugin consistency, job templates and accounts across multiple host architectures.  Developed a way to utilize limited disk space for multiple architecture builds by creating a merge utility for file/directory structures.  Maintained internal debian package repository.  Scripted the installation of Windows development system reducing what took developers days to less than an hour.   Tracked down build breaks, breakers (offenders) when necessary. Instrumented Make macros to utilize MD5 hash of source directory to either pull prebuilt packages from cache or perform builds in clean tree  (independent of any object files). Perform IT duties as necessary for the maintenance of build cluster (VSphere/VCenter) and team build servers (pure hardware).
positions.insights: Skills: Linux System Administration · Docker Products · Groovy · Server Administration

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Senior Software Engineer

Successfully converted more than 5 million files spanning thousands of branches and hundreds of modules from CVS/Subversion to Perforce without data loss and within desired tree structure.  Created automatic installation and configuration of Jenkins based upon release information stored in SQL tables.  Re-wrote SAS deployment tools to support new CM deployment and utilize information stored in SQL to help alleviate manual steps.  Performed monthly releases deploying software to more than twenty thousand servers spanning the globe. Implemented asset tracking for build artifacts in SQL to ensure reproducibility of software deployments in all supported staging and production environments.
positions.insights: Skills: Linux System Administration · Server Administration

positions.title: Bassist  and Background Vocals
positions.description:
Since 1992, bassist for numerous artists in the Salt Lake City area.  

I can be found on recordings by Brett Raymond, Kalai, Sam Cardon, Kurt Bestor, Paul Cardall as well as commercials and the big screen including the IMAX format.

positions.title: Build/Tools Engineer
positions.description: Completely automate complex build system using open source tools. Create software to bridge build system with Jira, along with in-house automated test system. Develop software to report test results back to build system for easy reference. Complete work to stage releases from experimental through general availability states. Provide automated build information via command line, web interface, RSS, email and Jabber. Tie LDAP authentication into secure web server (Apache) for use with build web based UI.
positions.insights: Skills: Linux System Administration · Server Administration

positions.title: Configuration and Release Manager
positions.description: Deployed automated build and integration environment to support diverse code base for Mac, Windows and Linux. Manage all builds, releases, and patches. Implement support controls to handle code from Accurev, Bazaar and Subversion. Migrate all AccuWork records and attachments to Jira using custom scripts written in Perl. Create backup schedule, deploy source cross reference and source browser for all projects.
positions.insights: Skills: Linux System Administration · Server Administration

positions.title: Global Perforce Administrator
positions.description: Maintain Perforce servers in the Salt Lake City office of Avalanche Studios for 250 users. Ensure 24x7 reliability. Create weekly checkpoints, perform regular database rebalancing to reduce size of metadata, write custom utilities to help improve performance of Perforce. Create custom triggers to enforce development policies, and tree locking. Create custom LDAP Authentication Bridge for integration into Perforce. Write software to evaluate new releases of Perforce before studio wide rollout.
positions.insights: Skills: Linux System Administration · Server Administration

positions.title: Principal Engineer
positions.description: Created and implemented agile automated build, notification, test and auditing system using CVS, Perforce, Subversion, MySQL and Perl for Unix, Linux, Solaris, HPUX and Windows. Manage releases/patches/hot fixes for large portal system. Created and implemented web tools for tree and build monitoring along with limited integration into defect tracking system. Created automated build installation and smoke test deployment system for complex portal product.
positions.insights: Skills: Linux System Administration · Server Administration

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Responsible for implementation, rollout and maintenance of Configuration Management system used for local development of add on products required by MetaFrame using Perforce and CVS as CM tools. Local modifications to CVS in order to support the auto-detection of file types using Unix magic style file. Developed automated client/server/Web based build system using Perl to maintain all local and remote builds providing around the clock build completion/error notification with subscription and submission information from both Perforce and build system. Setup LXR and ported supporting indexing tools from Unix to Windows NT for source cross reference. Ported rsync to Windows NT using Cygnus Cygwin32 tools in order to synchronize remote resources over low bandwidth network. Participated in creation of audio support for Citrix Systems ICA Java client. Created web based test harness for Citrix ICA Java client. Created installations for MetaFrame add on products.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Java Solutions Team. Creation of demos applications for use with Java on NetWare. Created JNI to expose low-level NetWare services and presented those services via RMI for Java. Created a Process Manager for NetWare to display CPU and Memory utilization, running NetWare processes, Java processes, allowing the launching of new Java processes through a directory browser. 
Source Integration and Configuration Management. Managed integration process for Java and UnixWare 2.0 development in Utah. Provided Engineering staff with standard development environment to ensure consistency of header files and libraries across multiple platforms. Built source tree on a daily basis to identify problem areas and provide both software engineers and test engineers with test packages. Enhanced CVS to track deltas made, as well as bugs fixed, with output written in HTML for use with internal Web Page. Responsible for integrating source code delivered from other development sites into local tree as well as update trees in other locations which were using different SCCS systems. Maintained servers from which engineers could install packages. Created programs used to install the JVM on IntranetWare using InstallShield. Provided backups and images via CD-Studio from Young Minds. Received the Novell Extra Mile Award for the integration of UnixWare 2.0, received Presidential Award from UNIVEL for work related to Services and Support seminars given across the country, and the design of Services and Support courses.
positions.insights: Skills: Linux System Administration · Server Administration

positions.title: Senior Support Engineer
positions.description: Provided end-user support for i386/i486 based products Interactive Systems offered which included UNIX, TCP/IP, NFS, RFS, X11, VP/ix, Novell Ported NetWare, SMB/ix and PCI. Supported end-user as well as internal customers on issues ranging from installation and administration, to advanced configuration and development. Responsibilities included the administration of a number of support machines, which included administration of TCP/IP, sendmail, and NFS. Wrote and implemented applications to assist support reps in identifying the exact nature of UNIX system error messages, signal messages, network messages. Ported and maintained contributed software for X11. First employee to be recognized for outstanding work by Scott McNealy upon the completion of the acquisition of Interactive Systems by SunSoft.
positions.insights: Skills: Linux System Administration · Server Administration

positions.title: Member of Technical Staff
positions.description: Provided end-user and development support for SunSoft/Interactive Unix environments and their add-on products.
positions.insights: Skills: Linux System Administration · Server Administration

positions.title: Data Services Technician
positions.description: Provided on site installation and maintenance of all AT&T data products.
